title: ZFS (Zettabyte File System) signature
summary: ZFS pool labels are located at the beginning and end of each vdev (disk). The label contains a 4KB block with magic 0x00BAB10C at offset 0 (the uberblock magic). The pool name and configuration are stored in the label's nvlist.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Labels are at offsets 0, 1 * 256KB, 2 * 256KB, 3 * 256KB from the start, and symmetrically from the end.
ZFS is a copy-on-write filesystem with built-in RAID (RAID-Z), snapshots, clones, compression, and checksums.
ZFS uses 256-bit checksums (Fletcher4 or SHA-256) for all data and metadata.
ZFS is used by FreeBSD, Linux (OpenZFS), and Illumos.
